findings.problem: Claims the tea 'cures tiredness' (banned cure/treat claim) and calls it 'the best tea in the world' (banned superlative). Also uses '!!!'.
findings.fix: Remove both claims and the '!!!'. Describe the fresh, fragrant ilaichi aroma instead, with at most one '!'.

findings.problem: 'LAST CHANCE: buy now before the offer ends tonight.' is in ALL CAPS, uses the banned 'buy now' pressure, and promises an unconfirmed deadline (rule 9).
findings.fix: Delete the line, or replace it with a calm invitation to join The Steep Club.

findings.problem: Wrong ending. 'Thanks, The team' replaces 'Until your next cup' and 'Ara, from the Kettlebird team'. There is no P.S. brewing tip and no two-line footer with {{company_address}} and {{unsubscribe_url}}.
findings.fix: End with 'Until your next cup,' / 'Ara, from the Kettlebird team' / 'P.S. Crush the ilaichi pods before brewing.' Then add the two-line footer, with two trailing spaces on the first line.

findings.problem: Preview uses fake pressure ('Last chance', 'before it is gone forever') and implies a deadline (rule 9).
findings.fix: Rewrite calmly, e.g. 'A fragrant magical box of tea, with a surprise every month.'

findings.problem: Subject still says 'this week only', which is fake pressure and an unconfirmed deadline (rule 9). The length is now fine at 35 characters.
findings.fix: Use something like 'Meet The Steep Club, friends'. This also adds the required 'friends'.

findings.problem: Greeting is 'Dear customer,', which the voice guide bans as too stiff. It also lacks the required {{first_name}}.
A second link ([Or shop here](.../shop)) breaks the one-main-link rule.
findings.fix: Remove the shop link and keep only [Join The Steep Club](https://kettlebird.example/steep-club).

findings.problem: The word 'friends' never appears (rule 5). The copy has no contractions and sounds stiff, which breaks rule 7 and the Charming, Warm, Chatty voice.
findings.fix: Add 'friends' and rewrite in a chatty tone with contractions such as 'we're' and 'you'll'.
